claim_boundary: T16-UTF-X1 is a large exploratory stress test downstream of T16-UTF. It freezes exact Unicode strings and exact item multisets for paired order and position contrasts, but model tokenization can still differ across prompts. Results describe hidden-state displacement conditional on recorded model, tokenizer, wrapper, sequence length, and token path. They do not establish tokenizer-independent Unicode composition, emoji meaning, a causal circuit, an instruction-tuning effect, a scale law, or model-population generality.
